document.abstract: (1.1) This standard defines the mapping of 2048 × 1080 pixel array into a 2200 sample × 1125 line interface structure as defined in SMPTE ST 274. — This standard specifies: — Pixel array structure, Digital Timing Reference Sequences (SAV, EAV) and Digital Representation for transmission with single link or multi-link SMPTE ST 292-1 or SMPTE ST 424. — Recommended Location of the color VANC packet defined in § 6.3 of SMPTE ST 2048-1.
